text: F1.4: the cipher table with a scrambled alphabet and a key stepped by a hand rule (skip a key letter every m letters, back and forth); 2,093 such rules agree with the 24 known letters.
Each rule: one search on K4, then scrambled copies fitting the same rule until one reads as well; 21,878 searches in all. Planted messages found 17 of 24.
K4 beats all 12 copies in 299 rules where chance gives 161, and all 100 in 66 where chance gives 21, yet every reading is gibberish: the next run checks the test itself (0254).
